table.name: museum
table.purpose: Lookup table of museums, one row per museum, with its name, staff count, and opening year. Visits (visit table) link visitors to museums via Museum_ID.

Museum_ID.name: Museum_ID
Museum_ID.description: Primary key identifying each museum; referenced by visit.Museum_ID. The joins to visitor.Level_of_membership and visit.visitor_ID are likely spurious statistical coincidences given the small integer domain.

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the museum; unique per row.

Num_of_Staff.name: Num_of_Staff
Num_of_Staff.description: Number of staff members employed at the museum (integer count, range 12–62).

Open_Year.name: Open_Year
Open_Year.description: Year the museum opened (2000–2012). Declared as VARCHAR but values are all four-digit years.

table.name: visit
table.purpose: Junction/fact table recording individual visits by visitors to museums, with the number of tickets purchased and the total amount spent on each visit. Each row is one visit by one visitor to one museum.

Museum_ID.name: Museum_ID
Museum_ID.description: Identifier of the museum visited; foreign key to museum.Museum_ID (e.g. 2 = Capital Plaza Museum, 4 = Willow Grande Museum).

Num_of_Ticket.name: Num_of_Ticket
Num_of_Ticket.description: Number of tickets purchased in this visit (integer count, 2–24).

Total_spent.name: Total_spent
Total_spent.description: Total amount of money spent on the visit, presumably in the local currency (e.g. dollars); values like 19.98–320.44, consistent with ticket count times price.

visitor_ID.name: visitor_ID
visitor_ID.description: Identifier of the visitor making the visit; foreign key to visitor.ID (e.g. 3 = Arjen Robben, 5 = Fernando Gago). The join to museum.Museum_ID is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap) and should be ignored.

table.name: visitor
table.purpose: One row per museum visitor: their ID, name, age, and the museum their membership is associated with. Visits by these visitors are recorded in the visit table via visitor_ID.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the visitor in years (values 25–56).

ID.name: ID
ID.description: Primary key of the visitor table; unique visitor identifier, referenced by visit.visitor_ID (each visitor can have many visits).

Level_of_membership.name: Level_of_membership
Level_of_membership.description: Despite its name, the join statistics show this column references museum.Museum_ID (values map to museum names such as 2 = Capital Plaza Museum, 8 = ZirMed Gateway Museum). It most likely identifies the museum the visitor is a member of (or their membership's home museum), not a membership tier. The name suggests a membership level, but the accepted join to museum.Museum_ID is stronger evidence; the exact semantic (which museum the membership belongs to) is tentative.

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the visitor (e.g., 'Arjen Robben', 'Gonzalo Higuaín'); unique per row.
